시편 123:1.content: A Song of degrees. Unto thee lift I up mine eyes, O thou that dwellest in the heavens.

시편 123:2.content: Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hand of their masters, and as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress; so our eyes wait upon the Lord our God, until that he have mercy upon us.

시편 123:3.content: Have mercy upon us, O Lord, have mercy upon us: for we are exceedingly filled with contempt.

시편 123:4.content: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease, and with the contempt of the proud.
